description: React component for calendar toggle UI, including calendar status display, installation prompt, and management actions.

classes.name: CalendarToggleItemProps
classes.description: Props for individual calendar toggle item, including title, subtitle, color, status, and calendar list.

classes.name: EmptyCalendarToggleItem
classes.description: Component displayed when no calendars are installed, with optional install action.

classes.name: ConnectedCalendarItem
classes.description: Data structure representing a connected calendar, including credentials, integration info, errors, and calendar list.

classes.name: CalendarToggleContainerComponentProps
classes.description: Props for the main calendar toggle container component, including connected calendars, loading state, and actions.

methods.name: CalendarToggleItem
methods.description: Renders a calendar item with status badge and toggle switches for each calendar.

methods.name: EmptyCalendarToggleItem
methods.description: Displays a prompt to install a calendar with optional action button.

methods.name: CalendarToggleContainerComponent
methods.description: Main component that displays list of connected calendars or installation prompt, with management actions.
